newsitem.title: UK: LME does not fine Albatros for contract breach.
newsitem.headline: LME does not fine Albatros for contract breach.

text.p: Breaches of contract by Albatros Warehousing BV earlier this year were serious enough to justify a substantial fine, but this is not being imposed, the LME said.

The LME Warehouse Disciplinary Committee held an enquiry in May and found that Albatros breached its contract by failing to maintain accurate records and properly issue LME warrants, as well as submitting incorrect stock returns on occasions.

"The Committee recognised, however, that the six-week suspension of the ability to issue LME warrants served by Albatros...and the consequent loss of business have in themselves been enough financial sanction," the LME said.
